This patch changes HDMI port registration order for the BayTrail platform.
The story is that in kernel version 3.11 i915 supported only one HDMI port -
the HDMIB port. So this port ended up being HDMI-1 in user-space.
But commit '6f6005a drm/i915: expose HDMI connectors on port C on BYT'
introduced HDMIC port support. And added HDMIC  registration prior to HDMIB
so HDMIB became HDMI-2 and HDMIC became HDMI-1.
Well
column2: this is fine as far as the kernel is concerned. i915 does not give any

column1: guarantees to the numbering
However
column2: this breaks wayland setup in Tizen IVI. We have only one single HDMI

column1: port on our hardware
column2: and it is connected to HDMIB. Our configuration relies on

column1: the fact that it is HDMI-1.
Well
column2: certainly this is user-space problem which was exposed with Jesse's

column1: patch. However
column2: there is a reason why we have to do this assumption - we use

column1: touchscreen monitors and we have to associate event devices with the monitors
and this is not easy to do dynamically
column2: so we just have a static setup.

column1: Anyway
column2: while the user-space setup will have to be fixed regardless

column1: chane the HDMI port registration order so that HDMIB stays HDMI-1
was in 3.11. Simply because there is no strong reason for changing the order in
the kernel
column2: and it'll help setups like ours in sense that we'll have more time

column1: for fixing the issue properly.
